name: gamba
description: A slot machine you spin while your agent works. Chips come only from the tokens it burns. No real money: satire.

tokens_per_chip.title: Tokens per chip
tokens_per_chip.description: How many burned tokens buy one spin. Lower means more chips per agent turn.

max_chips_per_turn.title: Max chips per turn
max_chips_per_turn.description: Cap on chips one agent turn can deposit, so a huge turn does not flood the balance.

limit_warn_percent.title: Weekly limit warning, %
limit_warn_percent.description: Warn once per week when this much of the weekly plan limit is used.
